## Design

### 2026-10-07 – Started working on Starbie and went through the Week 1 guide to understand the project requirements. I learned that Starbie involves designing a PCB in KiCad and later adding firmware using an ESP32-C

**2h**

Started working on Starbie and went through the Week 1 guide to understand the project requirements. I learned that Starbie involves designing a PCB in KiCad and later adding firmware using an ESP32-C3, OLED, buttons, MPU6050, and DHT11 sensor. I also set up my plan for starting the PCB design.

### 2026-10-11 – ![KiCad Project Manager Welcome Screen](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/taTFQVVC5EkrMraPWRbicI33nlnYX48g/8ae05e31b6e140a10eeb8b6609546eb047bf10dd1b0430e239368465785e8d

**1h**

![KiCad Project Manager Welcome Screen](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/taTFQVVC5EkrMraPWRbicI33nlnYX48g/8ae05e31b6e140a10eeb8b6609546eb047bf10dd1b0430e239368465785e8d2c.png)

Set up my Starbie project plan and reviewed the Week 1 guide. I explored the PCB design workflow in KiCad and identified the components needed, including the XIAO ESP32-C3, OLED display, buttons, MPU6050, and DHT11 sensor. Next, I plan to start drawing the schematic.
